children: Trader and Fullstack founder Flood posted his Hyperliquid account address and positions on X. According to Odaily, the account holds an 88.88 BTC long position with 20x leverage, opened at an average price of $68,866, with an unrealized loss of about $375,100 and a return of -123.44%.
The account also holds a short position of about 83,290 PRL, with an unrealized profit of about $47,100 and a return of 81.25%.

title: Flood Posts Hyperliquid Positions; BTC 20x Long Shows More Than $370,000 in Unrealized Losses
